caption: The drawing features two wooden objects set against a plain, light-colored background. Both objects have a brown color, indicative of wood grain texture. The object on the left is a rectangular open box with slightly curved sides towards the top and a handle slot cut into its upper back panel. The object on the right is a rectangular box with a hinged front panel that is shown open, folding downwards at an angle, with two visible metal hinges and a small vertical handle for opening and closing the panel. The right object is taller than the left, and both are drawn with clear lines and shading to emphasize their three-dimensional forms. The composition positions the two objects side by side with a small gap between them.
title: Shaker Wood Box
